# Yahoo Finance

> > Comprehensive financial platform providing live stock market data, quotes, portfolio tracking, and breaking business news with coverage of major indexes like the S&P 500 and Russell 2000.

Yahoo Finance aggregates market data from Reuters, Bloomberg, and Associated Press Finance, offering tools for stock screening, earnings calendars, cryptocurrency tracking, and global market analysis. The platform serves both retail investors and financial professionals with real-time quotes, charts, and economic indicators including GDP, inflation, and Federal Reserve policy updates.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market Data
- Live Quotes & Charts
- S&P 500 & Russell 2000
- Portfolio Tracking
- Earnings Reports
- Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin)
- Economic Indicators (GDP, Inflation)
- Federal Reserve Policy
- Market Screeners
- Currency Trading (Forex)
- Business News
- US Stocks & ETFs
- Tariffs & Trade Policy
- Market Trends & Analysis

## Core Platform

- [Yahoo Finance - Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News](https://finance.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Homepage with live stock quotes, market data, and financial news
- [Markets: World Indexes, Futures, Bonds, Currencies, Stocks & ETFs](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Markets overview with global indexes, futures, bonds, and commodities
- [Stock Portfolio Management & Tracker](https://finance.yahoo.com/portfolios/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Portfolio tracking tool with brokerage integration and performance metrics
- [Yahoo! Finance Canada](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/): Canadian edition homepage with local market data and economic news

## Financial News

- [Finance News: Wall Street, Financial Markets, Stocks & Securities](https://finance.yahoo.com/news?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Financial news hub covering stocks, markets, and corporate updates
- [Latest News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/latest-news/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Breaking financial news feed with real-time market updates

## Market Data & Screeners

- [Top Trending Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/trending/): Real-time screener of most-watched US stocks with price and volume data
- [Most Active Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/most-active/): Stock screener showing highest trading volume US equities with charts
- [Company Earnings Calendar](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings/): Earnings calendar tracking quarterly reports and EPS estimates

## Currency & Forex

- [EUR/USD (EURUSD=X) Live Rate, Chart & News](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/EURUSD=X/): EUR/USD forex pair with live rates, charts, and currency news
